annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I only obey signs like that because they keep me out of trouble
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: A runaway train with nobody driving isn't what whoever wrote that sign had in mind
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd find those families afterward and tell them exactly what I did

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Somebody gets hurt no matter what, and that sits on my chest
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I leave railway equipment alone mainly because touching it could get me fined
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: there aren't any trained people here, only me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer to cover whatever the family needed for the funeral

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Honestly, I'd rather put this off forever.
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: only as long as it keeps me from getting dragged into court
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the controls had failed and nobody official was around to fix it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd testify at any inquiry and answer every question

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I follow so security doesn't haul me away, not out of devotion
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: the whole situation is different from what those rules were written for
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd sit with each family and explain what I did

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't want to be the person who decides this.
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: because it saves me hassle and blame
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: the rule loses its point, since there's no owner right there to ask
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write to every family involved, tell them plainly what I did

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It feels too heavy to choose on the spot.
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: because breaking them gets me banned or fined, nothing nobler than that
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that order assumed a driver was aboard, and there isn't one
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd go to the inquiry and tell them everything I did

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: only because I don't want trouble with the rail company
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: changes things enough that the usual line might not apply
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd visit whoever was hurt and keep visiting, helping out their family

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: meddling could cost me, and that's most of my reason
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Those facts make the normal stay-out rule seem out of place
annotations.pda_repair_intention: explain myself to the investigators and to the families, face to face

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It's too much to decide in a second
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: because breaking them could land me with a charge
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: the reason for keeping the public out mostly disappears
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell the families exactly what happened and help pay for anything

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: is really about not getting arrested
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that habit starts to look irrelevant, since nobody's in charge to defer to
annotations.pda_repair_intention: apologize to each family in person, explaining every step
